summary: Hydro One Inc. filed a Form 6-K on May 22, 2026, attaching an underwriting agreement for a $1 billion offering of 4.750% senior notes due 2031. This is a routine debt issuance under an existing shelf registration, not a special situation. The notes are sold to underwriters (Barclays, Mizuho, RBC) for cash. No change of control, acquisition, tender, or restructuring is involved. The filing is a standard financing event.
